name: modules-provisioning
description: Write the provisioning script of the modules of a Jahia release, as its module manager offers them

scripts.package: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js "--banner:js=import {createRequire} from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm run format-check && npm test && npm run package
